name.ja: BB戦士 163武威凰大将軍 輝羅鋼極彩Ver.
name.en: BB Senshi 163 Buweiou General Kirako Gokusai Ver.

description.ja: • 2羽の結晶鳳凰が宿る大将軍…　ここに復活！
description.en: • A great general with two crystal phoenixes... He's back here!

description.ja: • 結晶輝羅鋼と呼ばれていたインモールド成形パーツが装いも新たに「輝羅鋼極彩シール」で復活！更に緻密に表現された「四枚の翼」でパワーアップ。
description.en: • The in-mold molded parts that were called crystalline Kirako are back with a new look, "Kirako Gokusai Seal "! Powered up with even more precisely expressed " four wings".

description.ja: • 成形色・輝羅鋼シール・ホイルシール・メッキにより組み立てただけで、設定に近いカラフルな仕上がり！接着剤不要で、気軽に組み立てることができる。
description.en: • A colorful finish close to the setting can be achieved by just assembling the molding color, Kira Steel Seal, Foil Seal, and plating! No adhesive required, easy assembly.

description.ja: • 対翼鳳凰と合体！武威凰大将軍が対翼鳳凰装着形態に変化。
description.en: • Combined with the anti-wing phoenix! General Wu Weihuang changes to the form where he is equipped with a pair of winged phoenixes.

description.ja: • 飛行形態へ変化可能。 成形品×7、ホイルシール×1、輝羅鋼シール×1、組立説明書
description.en: • Can change to flight form. Molded product x 7, foil seal x 1, Kira steel seal x 1, assembly manual
